title: sqliteRow
responsibility: Decodes a SQLite result row into model properties, restoring JSON values and booleans.

inputs.name: sqliteRow.model
inputs.description: The SqliteModel for one table; sqliteRow reads only its fields map, where each property's SqliteField gives the row column (its column, or toSnakeCase(property) when column is absent) and the type that selects the decoding. The table and primaryKey members are never read by sqliteRow.

inputs.name: sqliteRow.row
inputs.description: A SQLite result row, keyed by column name; null or undefined makes sqliteRow return null without reading any column. Any other value is read by column name, and a column absent from the row reads as undefined: a boolean field then decodes to false, a json field makes sqliteRow throw a SyntaxError, and other fields pass undefined through.
inputs.unknownReason: The driver returns an unchecked row; each column is converted according to the SQLite model descriptor.

outputs.name: sqliteRow
outputs.description: The record built from the row, with one key per entry of model.fields: null values stay null, stored json text is parsed, boolean values are coerced with Boolean, and values of the string, number and blob types are returned unchanged. It is null when the row is null or undefined, and the record is cast to T without any check against the model.

errors.name: SyntaxError
errors.description: Thrown by JSON.parse when a json field's stored value is not valid JSON text, including when its column is absent from the row, since String(undefined) is the text undefined.
